Upscale, Spacious Floor Plans

Our Shadyside Pittsburgh apartments at Shadyside Commons offer you luxury one- and two-bedroom floor plans in Pittsburgh’s East End. Our designs and construction methods are environmentally conscious. Our apartments provide ample closet space with adjustable shelving and custom storage, as well as an individual washer and dryer in every unit and amenities that deliver convenience and comfort.

Take a look at each available floor plan or view our virtual apartment tour videos. Read through our Frequently Asked Questions to learn more about living at Shadyside Commons and then contact a leasing agent to learn how to lease your new home today.

If you don’t see an apartment for your time frame, please contact us for more information as we are accepting wait list applications.
